manifest.cpu_scope: serial, one CPU affinity,120s per query,1500s total wall budget per invocation
manifest.ddr4: two pinned rows omitted; parent preserves unchanged
manifest.model: 45nm ITRS LOP0.7V/360K; not Nangate SRAM macro characterization

cache.l1.read.assumption: LRU/pf_lru replacement-state RMW folded into array accesses; khkw_split indexing costs zero. Fill count is demand-miss plus accepted-prefetch upper-bound proxy, including merged/retried demand misses. Exact original memory geometry at native CACTI7 45nm ITRS LOP0.7V/360K; no nearest-geometry or technology scaling. Cache includes tags and uses one RW port; SRAM uses one read and one write port. Per-access dynamic and per-physical-unit area/leakage; standing instances are not multiplied here. ITRS model, not a measured Nangate SRAM macro.
